mapper.select: SELECT S.SCHEDULE_CODE AS VALUE , S.SCHEDULE_NAME AS NAME FROM INTERFACE_SCHEDULE S WHERE S.COMPANY_CODE = #{company_code} AND TO_CHAR(CURRENT_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN S.APPLY_FROM_DATE AND COALESCE(NULLIF(S.APPLY_TO_DATE, ''), '99991231') ORDER BY S.SCHEDULE_CODE

SELECT D.DIVISION_CODE AS VALUE , CONCAT(D.DIVISION_CODE, ' - ', D.DIVISION_NAME) AS NAME FROM DIVISION D WHERE D.COMPANY_CODE = #{company_code} AND D.STATUS = 'Y' ORDER BY D.DIVISION_NAME, D.DIVISION_CODE

SELECT M.IF_CODE AS VALUE , CONCAT(M.IF_CODE, ' - ', COALESCE(I.IF_NAME, M.IF_CODE)) AS NAME FROM INTERFACE_SCHEDULE_MAPPING M LEFT JOIN INTERFACE_ITEM_MST I ON I.IF_CODE = M.IF_CODE AND I.COMPANY_CODE = M.COMPANY_CODE WHERE M.COMPANY_CODE = #{company_code} AND M.SCHEDULE_CODE = #{schedule_code} ORDER BY M.SCHEDULE_SEQ

SELECT D.COLUMN_NAME , D.SOURCE_COLUMN , D.TARGET_COLUMN , D.HISTORY_COLUMN , D.COLUMN_REQUIRED_YN FROM INTERFACE_ITEM_DTL D WHERE D.IF_CODE = #{if_code} AND D.COMPANY_CODE = #{company_code} AND D.COLUMN_TRANS_TYPE = 'I' AND D.USING_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY D.INTERFACE_ITEM_DTL_ID
